title: Operator
description: One operator: data/operators/<id>.json. Icons are found by convention: icons/operators/<id>.svg|png|webp and icons/abilities/<ability.id>.svg|png|webp.

id.description: Permanent id, equal to the file name. Never change it once published; add the old id to aliases if it really has to change.

legacyId.description: Id used by app versions before 2.0.0 (a0 … a38, d0 … d37). Only for operators that existed then; never add one to a new operator.

type.description: standard: one gadget per round. gadgetKit: the player picks gadgetPicks gadgets from a larger pool (Striker, Sentry).

roles.description: Ubisoft roles as shown in the game's operator menu, most important first.

released.description: Season in which the operator arrived, for example "Y11S3". Launch operators use "Y1S0".

id.description: Unique across all operators. The icon is icons/abilities/<id>.svg|png|webp.

gadgets.description: General gadget ids (data/gadgets) of the operator's side.

gadgetPicks.description: How many gadgets the operator takes into a round. 1 for standard operators, 2 for gadget-kit operators.

aliases.description: Earlier ids of this operator. Saved settings and presets that use an alias are mapped to the current id.
